title: Questions. Please help... Dream Police? Aliens?
content: I've only recently found out that Mall World is what I've been dreaming/traveling my whole life, since age 5, now 52/f... Only recently heard of the dream police and met one in a dream where I was in a different era and continent, felt like a parallel universe. I kept asking everyone where I was, and they answered me like "I've told you this 100 times" and saying I was having another episode with my mental illness, but I didn't know anyone. Finally ran into an "officer", female, with a mostly human face, but it was her uniform that held her form together enough to make her look human. I confronted her with everything, and all she did was give me a soft reassuring smile but never spoke. I got angry and told her my husband was about to wake up to my corpse, that my Mom in Heaven wasn't going to understand when she found out I died and then couldn't find my soul. I told her I've been to both Heaven and Hell and this was neither. Her expression changed? She had an expression I can't give a name that would tell the emotion I felt from her, maybe hurt or remembrance? I finally got desperate and asked her what year it was. She said 1965, only time she spoke. I told her I'm not going to be born for another 18 years and that I need to get back to 2025 NOW. She gave me that warm smile again and nodded. I walked away, got into the passenger side of the vehicle and when I looked at her I passed out onto the dashboard and opened my eyes in my bed... I've had previous dreams about humanoid beings that feel relevant to this now, like astral projection, my soul jumping off a cloud and trying to fly away but being caught again and told if I do that again I won't wake up. Sorry for the long intro, but this is all so new to me, and to finally have a name for all the specific places I've been and other people who have experienced it is like being told you're not crazy by someone who gets it 🤟
